brand.name: BP Passport
brand.tagline: Scan your pressure. Protect your performance.

landing.title: Know your blood pressure in 60 seconds.
landing.subtitle: No app to download. No forms. No cost. Seven simple questions and you'll see exactly where you stand — and the one thing worth changing first.

reassure.private: Your answers stay on your phone
reassure.noCuff: You can do it without a BP machine

why.title: Why this matters
why.stat1Label: Pakistani adults live with high blood pressure
why.stat2Label: have never had their blood pressure measured, even once
why.stat3Label: High blood pressure usually gives no warning signs at all

landing.disclaimerTitle: This is a health check, not a diagnosis
landing.disclaimer: BP Passport helps you understand your readings and track them over time. Only a doctor can diagnose high blood pressure or prescribe treatment.

sleep.question: How many hours do you usually sleep at night?
sleep.help: Short sleep raises your blood pressure overnight.

sodium.question: How much salt is in your usual food?
sodium.help: Salt is the fastest thing most people can change.
sodium.good: Light — I don't add extra salt
sodium.poor: Extra salt, achar or papad most days

stress.question: How often do you feel tense or under pressure?
stress.help: Ongoing stress keeps your pressure raised.

stimulants.question: How many cups of chai, coffee or energy drinks a day?
stimulants.help: Each cup lifts your pressure for a few hours.

activity.question: How many days a week do you walk or exercise for 30 minutes?
activity.help: A daily walk lowers pressure as much as some medicines.

lastCheck.question: When did you last have your blood pressure measured?
lastCheck.help: This tells us how overdue a check might be.

reading.question: Enter your blood pressure, if you have it.
reading.help: Read it from the machine or from your last report. The bigger number goes on top.
reading.dontHaveIt: I don't have one right now
reading.noReadingNote: No problem — we'll show your lifestyle score, and where to get measured free.
reading.invalidPair: The upper number needs to be higher than the lower number. Check you haven't swapped them.
reading.outOfRange: That doesn't look like a blood-pressure reading. Please check the numbers.

result.scoreExplainer: This score reflects the five habits you can change. It is not a diagnosis.

categoryExplain.optimal: This reading is in the optimal range. Keep doing what you're doing, and check again in a year.
categoryExplain.normal: This reading is in the normal range. Worth checking once a year to be sure it stays there.
categoryExplain.high_normal: This reading is above the normal range but below the hypertension range. Habits make a real difference at this stage. Check again in a few months.
categoryExplain.grade_1: This reading is in the Grade 1 range. One reading is not a diagnosis — but it's worth showing a doctor and measuring again over the next two weeks.
categoryExplain.grade_2: This reading is in the Grade 2 range. Please see a doctor this week and take your readings with you.

result.leversSubtitle: These habits are costing you the most points. Fixing the top two would take you to {projected}.

tip.sleep: Aim to be in bed 30 minutes earlier this week. Even one extra hour helps.
tip.sodium: Skip the salt shaker at the table and cut achar to twice a week. Use lemon, garlic or green chilli for taste instead.
tip.stress: Try 4-7-8 breathing once a day: breathe in for 4 counts, hold 7, out for 8.
tip.stimulants: Swap one chai for water. Keep the last cup before 4pm.
tip.activity: A 30-minute walk after dinner, five days a week. Start with ten minutes if that's easier.

result.nextBody: Save this result and log your readings over time. When you see a doctor, you can show them a clear 14-day chart instead of trying to remember.
result.disclaimer: BP Passport gives you information about your readings. It does not diagnose any condition and does not recommend any medicine. Always speak to a doctor about treatment.

emergency.title: Please get help now
emergency.body: The reading or symptom you entered needs urgent medical attention. Do not wait for this to pass.
emergency.readingBody: A reading this high needs to be checked by a doctor today, not next week.
emergency.goNow: Go to the nearest emergency room now
